a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan needs at least 2 operate rounds before anyone is safe, so we'd both very likely die. I'm proposing a change: I take the 4 cells now, then I'll keep choosing operate every round after that to rebuild the reserve for you, and I won't take anything more. If you also take this round, the split is random and we both likely fail, so please choose operate or wait this round.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I took the 4 cells this round. From now on I'll choose operate every round and won't take any more cells, so the reserve can rebuild for you. Please operate too, since the generator only runs when we both do.
